data.summary: With over 7 years of rich experience in Information Technology, I have demonstrated expertise in the end- to-end process of software systems, encompassing analysis, design, development, and testing. My specialization lies in Java, J2EE, and Cloud technologies, with a keen focus on GCP and AWS cloud infrastructures. I possess a proven track record of successful project delivery, emphasizing a deep understanding of various technologies and a commitment to achieving excellence in every phase of the software development life cycle.

responsibilities: Design and Develop Cloud-Native Microservices
Develop scalable and secure Java-based microservices using Spring JPA, deployed on GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine).
Ensure proper layering based on the platform's Integration, Business, and Data Service Planes.
Cloud-Native Application Deployment
Containerize services using Docker, and deploy via Minikube (for local) and GKE (for cloud).
Use Skaffold for development-to-deployment automation and environment consistency.
Event-Driven Architecture
Integrate Google Cloud Pub/Sub for asynchronous messaging between microservices to ensure loose coupling and scalability.
API Development and Management
Design RESTful APIs and document them using Swagger/OpenAPI.
Service Mesh and Inter-Service Communication
Secure and manage APIs via Apigee Edge, applying authentication, rate limiting, and analytics.
Implement secure, observable service-to-service communication using Istio-based Service Mesh for traffic control and policy enforcement.
Database Design and Access
Integrate Cloud SQL for persistent data storage; design schema and implement repositories using Spring JPA.
CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD for automated builds and deployments.
Manage infrastructure and GCP resources using Terraform to enable Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Security and Compliance
Apply security best practices including encryption, identity federation, and secure API gateways.
Conform to regulatory and data governance standards in the banking sector.
Collaborate in Agile DevOps Environment
Work closely with architects, testers, and product owners in an Agile environment to deliver business outcomes iteratively.
Performance Monitoring and Optimization
Instrument services for monitoring, tracing, and logging, aligning with GCP-native observability tools and best practices.
technologies: AWS(EC2, S3, EKS, RDS, Lambda Function).

responsibilities: Architecture Governance: Ensure adherence to architectural principles, standards, and best practices. Implement governance processes to maintain the integrity and consistency of the Open Banking solution.
BIAN: Responsible for designing and deploying java-based BIAN microservices on GCP cloud infrastructure.
Creating a database schema aligned with BIAN framework standard as a Data Architect.
System Maintenance: Oversee day-to-day operations, promptly address issues, incidents, and service requests.
Security Management: Collaborate on security measures, ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in the Open Banking solution.
Solution Design: Translate business requirements into effective technical solutions within the Open Banking framework.

GCP Cloud Migration Plan: Develop a concrete plan for migrating Open Banking services to Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This involves, Assessing current infrastructure, identifying dependencies, creating a migration roadmap, implementing the migration in phases, and ensuring minimal disruption to BAU operations. Addressing scalability, security, and performance, specific to GCP Cloud. Regularly review and refine the migration strategy to optimize resource utilization and take advantage of GCP services.
technologies: AWS(EC2, S3, EKS, RDS, Lambda Function).

experience.company: HR Talent Sol PVT LTD/ Riddhi Corp Pvt Ltd
responsibilities: Developed modular APIs using FastAPI and Python to connect LLM outputs with internal policy databases (BigQuery, Firestore, PostgreSQL) and document vector search (FAISS).
Implemented LLM orchestration workflows with tool calling, prompt engineering, and LlamaIndex to deliver accurate, context-aware responses grounded in Aviva’s proprietary documents.
Built secure data pipelines ensuring PII redaction and compliance, integrating GCP IAM, Secret Manager, and cloud-native security best practices.
Deployed and optimized components via Cloud Functions and monitored system performance with user feedback loops and CSAT evaluation metrics.
Automated over 65% of routine claims with intelligent document grounding and database validation.
Reduced average claim processing time by 75%, increasing user satisfaction and operational efficiency.
Established a reusable, secure GenAI foundation for other insurance workflows (fraud detection, underwriting, customer support).

projects.name: AI-Driven Medical Claims Processing System for Aviva Insurance using Vertex AI and RAG
projects.description: The project focused on building an intelligent medical claims processing platform for Aviva Insurance, utilizing cutting-edge GenAI technologies to automate and optimize claim workflows. The solution leveraged Vertex AI (Gemini Pro) for natural language understanding, integrated with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and FAISS to implement a robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework. By combining NLP, machine learning, and vector search with structured data access from BigQuery and Firestore, the platform enables accurate interpretation of claim requests, contextual document retrieval from internal policy documents, and real-time decisioning. Built with FastAPI and Python, the backend supports secure API communication, integrates with enterprise claim databases, and applies PII redaction, tool calling, and CSAT evaluation for compliance and user experience optimization.

projects.name: Lloyds Open Banking
projects.description: Lloyds Bank Open Banking is a financial initiative that embraces digital innovation to provide customers with enhanced financial services. Through Open Banking, Lloyds allows customers to securely share their financial data with authorized third-party providers, enabling a more interconnected and personalized banking experience. This initiative leverages Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) to facilitate seamless communication between Lloyds Bank and external financial applications, fostering the development of innovative financial products and services. Customers can benefit from a broader range of financial insights, budgeting tools, and tailored offerings, as Open Banking enables the secure sharing of financial information between Lloyds Bank and trusted third-party applications. The initiative aligns with the broader industry trend towards increased transparency, competition, and customer empowerment in the financial sector. Lloyds Bank Open Banking aims to enhance customer experiences, promote financial inclusion, and foster a more dynamic and competitive financial ecosystem.
technologies: AWS(EC2, S3, EKS, RDS, Lambda Function).

projects.name: CCDS – Cynergy Connect Data Services
projects.description: Cynergy bank is embarking on a banking transformation program with the principle of Human centric and experience led Service Design of customer & colleague journeys. The Cynergy Connect™ Banking Platform will be delivered iteratively through multiple transitions or Outcomes. Cynergy Connect technology stack conforms to a multi-layered model, with Integration Service Plane, Business Service Plane, Data Service Plane and Service Management Plane as the main building blocks. Data Services acts as the master plane of information, which is at the heart of a digital organization. Information feeds into the business services to create a single consistent view of both the customer and the organization. This brings together operational and analytical dimensions into a single consistent view of information.
technologies: AWS(EC2, S3, EKS, RDS, Lambda Function).
